text:
Rina (Marketing): Quick thread to lock the benchmark narrative for next week's launch. Need two clear assets: a hero line chart (latency vs $/1k tokens) and a compact savings heatmap. Primary audience: engineers & platform buyers.
Ethan (Growth): Keep hero copy short. CTA should drive to a tiny calc on the landing page. We want an immediate "Estimate your savings" hook. :rocket:
Priya (Product Marketing): Agreed. Proposed framing: "Production economics: latency you can predict, cost you can control." No model name callouts. Call out use cases (chat, search, embeddings) as buckets.
Sam (Design): I'll do two variations: 1) strong-contrast hero for landing, 2) condensed for email header. Need the CSVs to plot. Also will create a microcalc UX pattern (single input: avg tokens per call + calls/day -> show monthly savings).
Maya (Data): I'll produce two CSVs from anonymized telemetry. Data plan: sample 30M calls last quarter, stratify by token length (30/150/600), simulate batching factors (1, 4, 8) and cache hit rates (0%-70%). Expect draft numbers in ~3 hours.
Rina: Awesome. Quick naming rule for chart axes: X axis = latency (ms), Y axis = cost per 1k tokens ($). Normalize curves to our 100ms point so viewers can read relative differences.
Ethan: For email subject lines, we should A/B test: a) "Cut inference spend without trading performance" b) "How teams cut inference costs 30%+ (live demo)". Priya: Keep both but emphasize verifiable claims.
Priya: For the heatmap, suggestion: rows = prompt length buckets, cols = optimization levers (batching, cache, quant) showing % cost reduction. Caption: "Typical savings by prompt length & optimization".
Sam: Will use 3-color divergent scale, annotate top-left and bottom-right cells with examples. Also adding alt-text for accessibility.
Maya: Example sample rows I'll output:
```
# hero_lines.csv
latency_ms,redwood_opt,benchmark_avg
75,0.05,0.11
125,0.07,0.14
250,0.12,0.27
400,0.22,0.48
```
and
```
# heatmap.csv
prompt_bucket,lever,cost_reduction_pct
0-50,batching,6
0-50,cache,3
51-200,batching,18
51-200,cache,28
201-1000,batching,35
201-1000,cache,52
```
Ethan: Perfect. Routing idea: add a hidden form field capturing "estimated savings tier" (low/medium/high) so SDRs can prioritize. We'll map: <15% -> low, 15-35% -> medium, >35% -> high.
Priya: We'll add a short methodology note under the charts: data sources, normalization to 100ms baseline, and assumptions (no training-time changes, prices modeled on typical managed endpoints). Keep it 2-3 bullets.
Rina: Timeline: Maya deliver CSVs in 3 hours, Sam drops first mocks in 6 hours, Priya drafts copy by end of day. We'll iterate tomorrow morning.
NotifyBot: Reminder set: check-in scheduled for Rina tomorrow 10:30am PT.
Maya: Uploaded draft CSVs to the shared folder: https://drive.company/s/bench-2026 (will update exact path). Included uncertainty bands in the hero CSV for the 10/90 percentiles.
Sam: Figma frames uploaded: hero (variant A/B), email header, microcalc wireframe. Comments on color contrast and mobile sizing added.
Priya: Draft copy added to the deck with the 3-bullet methodology. Also included short social captions.
Ethan: I'll wire the landing to include the microcalc (JS snippet placeholder) and the hidden savings tier field. Draft of email subject/body uploaded to the growth folder.
Rina: Great momentum. Final asks: keep public claims conservative and link to methodology. We'll finalize visuals Monday morning and lock the webinar promo. Thanks all :clap:
